summary: Fixed FuncParamType.convert in src/click/types.py: when the plain function passed as a parameter type raises ValueError, the exception's message (str(e)) is now used as the BadParameter message; if the ValueError carries no message, the previous behavior (reporting the offending value, decoding bytes as UTF-8 with replacement on UnicodeError) is kept. Verified with a repro script (message preserved; no-message and bytes-value fallbacks unchanged) and by running tests/test_types.py, tests/test_options.py, tests/test_basic.py, tests/test_arguments.py, tests/test_info_dict.py — all pass (801 tests).

Fixed the usage-error hint line in click's UsageError.show so it only suggests a help option name that the command's own parameters don't take over (via Command.get_help_option_names, which subtracts command params' opts/secondary_opts from ctx.help_option_names). When several valid names remain, the longest is chosen (preferring --help over -h, breaking ties by original order); when none remain, no hint line is printed. Verified with a reproduction (group with -h/--help where the subcommand takes -h for --host: now hints 'Try \'cli foo --help\' for help.') and the full test suite (1438 passed, 23 skipped). Added two regression tests to tests/test_formatting.py.

Fixed HelpFormatter.write_usage in src/click/formatting.py: when args is empty, it now writes a single line (indented prefix + prog + newline) and returns early, instead of falling through to the wrap-text logic which produced an empty line or stray extra lines. Non-empty args path is unchanged. Added regression tests in tests/test_formatting.py covering narrow/wide widths, custom prefix, long program names, and nonzero current_indent. All formatting/command/basic tests pass (204 passed).

Fixed _set_path in appcfg/loader.py to create missing intermediate dicts when applying APP__ environment overrides (previously KeyError on paths not in defaults, e.g. APP__CACHE__REDIS__URL). Overrides of existing keys keep their coerced type (int/float/bool); new keys stay strings; DEFAULTS is untouched (deep copy in load). Added tests for new-path creation and DEFAULTS non-mutation; all 6 tests pass and the staging crash scenario now loads correctly.

Rewrote ledger/importer.py to use the csv module (io.StringIO) instead of naive line.split(","), so quoted fields with commas, escaped quotes (""), and embedded line breaks parse correctly. parse_rows now skips blank lines via a content check, pads short rows so missing optional cells yield "", and lowercases/strips headers as before. _parse_amount now also strips thousands separators (commas) in addition to $, spaces, and parentheses negatives. Verified: the failing sample file imports (3 transactions, net -1296.70), multi-line quoted memos work, and all 5 existing pytest tests pass.

Fixed DST handling in cronlite/schedule.py. Root cause: _plus_one_day used UTC-aware arithmetic (t.astimezone(utc) + 1 day), which crosses DST transitions incorrectly (e.g. Sydney fell back by an hour, producing 08:00 instead of 09:00). Also runs_between iterated from the shifted result instead of the configured wall-clock time. Fix: added _wall_clock_time() that builds the aware datetime directly from date+hour/minute, verifies round-trip through UTC, prefers the first occurrence for ambiguous (fall-back) times, and shifts forward minute-by-minute to the first valid local time for nonexistent (spring-forward gap) times. _plus_one_day and next_daily_run now always build from the configured wall-clock hour/minute on the target date. runs_between keeps the at-or-after-start / strictly-before-end semantics. Added 4 regression tests (Sydney fall-back, NY spring-forward, gap-time shift, strict end); all 9 tests pass.

Added --since/--until YYYY-MM-DD flags to the logsum CLI. Request date is the calendar date in the log timestamp (local date, not UTC-converted). Both flags combine; malformed dates print "logsum: error: invalid date: <value>" to stderr and exit 2 (strict YYYY-MM-DD parsing rejects e.g. 2026-1-1). Output format unchanged. Added tests (4 pass).

Rewrote search_notes in notes/db.py to use parameterized queries (owner, term, tag) and literal LIKE matching by escaping backslash, % and _ with ESCAPE '\'. Search semantics unchanged: case-insensitive substring on title/body, owner isolation, optional exact tag filter, newest first. Existing tests pass; manual checks confirm ' OR '1'='1, don't, 100% and a_b behave correctly.

Fixed fetch_all() in crm/client.py: replaced the floor-division page loop (which dropped the final partial page and over-requested on exact multiples) with a ceiling division over total, so it makes exactly one request per needed page, starting at offset 0 and never requesting offsets >= total. Also validates page_size > 0. Verified with a check script across totals 0..120 (120/100-contact case now returns all 120 with exactly 3 requests) and existing tests plus new tests in tests/test_pagination.py (7 pass).

Fixed shop/pricing.py: bulk discount now applies at qty >= 10 (was > 10); coupon is a percentage off the pre-tax subtotal (was percentage of subtotal+tax); tax is 10% of the discounted subtotal (was on subtotal); all rounding uses half-up via exact Fraction arithmetic (was banker's round via round() on floats). Cart checkout behavior flows through unchanged. Full suite (7 tests) passes.
